text.en:
2394
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
municipal district of Pantao-Ragat; on the east, by the municipality
of Balo-i, separated by the present boundary between Pantao-Ragat
and Balo-i; on the south, by the remaining portion of the municipal
district of Pantao-Ragat, separated by a straight line. coming from
the old boundary between the municipal district of Pantao-Ragat
and the municipality or Kolambugan and passes the boundary
between the barrio of Pantao-Ragat, seat of the municipal district
government of Pantao-Ragat, and Bangco, a barrio of the proposed
municipal district of Matungao, nearest to the above barrio of Pantao-
Ragat; and on the west by the municipality of Kolambugan, separated
by the present boundary between the municipality of Kolambugan
and the municipal district of Pantao-Ragat.
The municipal district of Matungao shall begin to exist upon the
appointment and qualification of the mayor, vice-mayor, and a
majority of the councilors thereot.
Done in the City of Manila, this 20th day of Jae, in
the year or our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORC EVANGELISTA
Executive, Secretary
